import re
import sys
import zipfile
import xml.etree.ElementTree as ET

import numpy as np
import statsmodels.api as sm

if not getattr(statsmodels, "__version__", ""):
    raise RuntimeError("statsmodels import/version check failed")

input_path = sys.argv[1]
main_ns = "http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/spreadsheetml/2006/main"
ns = {"m": main_ns}

def column_index(cell_ref):
    letters = re.match(r"[A-Z]+", cell_ref).group(0)
    idx = 0
    for ch in letters:
        idx = idx * 26 + (ord(ch) - 64)
    return idx - 1

with zipfile.ZipFile(input_path, "r") as workbook:
    shared_root = ET.fromstring(workbook.read("xl/sharedStrings.xml"))
    shared_strings = []
    for si in shared_root.findall("m:si", ns):
        shared_strings.append("".join(t.text or "" for t in si.iter("{%s}t" % main_ns)))

    sheet_root = ET.fromstring(workbook.read("xl/worksheets/sheet1.xml"))
    sheet_rows = {}
    for row in sheet_root.findall(".//m:sheetData/m:row", ns):
        row_number = int(row.get("r"))
        values = {}
        for cell in row.findall("m:c", ns):
            value_node = cell.find("m:v", ns)
            if value_node is None or value_node.text is None:
                value = None
            elif cell.get("t") == "s":
                value = shared_strings[int(value_node.text)]
            else:
                value = value_node.text
            values[column_index(cell.get("r"))] = value
        sheet_rows[row_number] = values

header = sheet_rows.get(1, {})
header_names = {value: idx for idx, value in header.items() if value is not None}
if "Efficacy" not in header_names or "BMI" not in header_names:
    raise RuntimeError("Required Efficacy and BMI headers were not found")
efficacy_col = header_names["Efficacy"]
bmi_col = header_names["BMI"]

records = []
rows_seen = 0
rows_excluded = 0
for row_number in sorted(k for k in sheet_rows if k > 1):
    row = sheet_rows[row_number]
    efficacy = row.get(efficacy_col)
    bmi_raw = row.get(bmi_col)
    if efficacy is None and bmi_raw is None:
        continue
    rows_seen += 1
    if efficacy is None or bmi_raw is None or str(bmi_raw).strip() == "":
        rows_excluded += 1
        continue
    if efficacy not in ("PR", "SD", "PD"):
        raise RuntimeError("Unexpected efficacy category: %r" % (efficacy,))
    records.append((1 if efficacy == "PR" else 0, float(bmi_raw)))

if not records:
    raise RuntimeError("No complete Efficacy/BMI observations were found")
y = np.asarray([r[0] for r in records], dtype=float)
bmi = np.asarray([r[1] for r in records], dtype=float)
X = sm.add_constant(bmi, has_constant="add")
result = sm.Logit(y, X).fit(disp=False, maxiter=200)

print("metric\tvalue")
print("AIC\t%.17g" % float(result.aic))
print("response\tPR_vs_nonPR")
print("predictor\tBMI")
print("model\tLogit(PR==1) ~ 1 + BMI")
print("n_rows_seen\t%d" % rows_seen)
print("n_rows_used\t%d" % int(result.nobs))
print("n_rows_excluded\t%d" % rows_excluded)
print("log_likelihood\t%.17g" % float(result.llf))
print("parameter_count\t%d" % len(result.params))
